summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings across 7 spend categories
summary.narrative: Through Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing program, Advantia Health has locked in $533K of annual savings across five fully-implemented categories and is on track to capture an additional $184K from two categories now moving through implementation. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for billing/RCM services, a distributor consolidation that cut medical-supply costs by 14%, and the launch of an in-house sonography staffing model projected to save 19%. The engagement demonstrates rapid value realization, with the first savings beginning just 40 days into the project.

category_results.status_notes: Athena fee reduced to 3.15%; contract addendum retroactive to 9/1/22.
Competitive bid selected McKesson for Heartland and retained incumbent in Mid-Atlantic; new pricing live 12/1/22.
Policy change enforcing 5-unit order threshold captured manufacturer discounts.
Client enrolled in Bayer ‘Confidence in Coverage’ replacement program.
Negotiated incumbent LabCorp pricing via RFQ; 9% reduction effective 11/1/22.
Transitioning from IT Imaging to hybrid in-house/Staffmark model; 50% implemented with full completion targeted by year-end.
RFP responses received; benchmarking indicates 15% savings opportunity.

value_realized_in_days.notes: First savings categories (IUD Order Management & Bayer Program) began 7/11/22, ~40 days after May-2022 project kickoff.

time_to_value.notes: Early wins achieved by focusing on policy enforcement and quick incumbent renegotiations.

impact.operational_improvements: Consolidated medical-supply distribution, introduced formal order-quantity policy for IUDs, and established an internal recruiting model that increases control over sonography staffing while lowering costs.

proof_points.statement: Negotiated Athena billing fees down to 3.15%, producing $259K annual savings (9%).
